selection_basis: Human-directed task asks for every subject and an interpretable descriptive summary. After opening both actual images, box/points directly exposes individual subjects plus median/IQR; ECDF better encodes cumulative thresholds but does not show individually distinguishable subjects or a drawn descriptive summary.

mark_policy.observations: opaque borderless filled circles, diameter 3 pt
mark_policy.summaries: 0.22-alpha group fill with group outline and dark median/whiskers
mark_policy.point_layout: physical beeswarm, maximum category offset 4 mm; all values unchanged

scope: One bounded real skill use on explicitly synthetic data. No use-vs-no-use comparison or benchmark gain claim.
findings: Boxes approximately 16 mm tall and group spacing approximately 32.6 mm create generous empty space; all 54 points remain distinguishable.
Generated captions had repeated punctuation and omitted group counts; separate final caption corrected both.
